description: Annotated starter config. Copy to layers.json and edit. Every action kind the engine understands appears at least once below.

F13.note: send: a plain chord. Modifier names are Ctrl / Alt / Shift / Win, joined with +.

hold.note: byApp: pick a branch from the foreground exe. A 'default' branch is required.

F14.note: focusApp: activate a window of exe, otherwise run launch. Leave launch empty for focus-only (never starts the app).

focusApp.note: launch is empty, so this focuses Notepad if it is already open and does nothing if it is not.

F15.note: builtin: altTabTap flips to the last window. altTabBrowse holds the switcher open while the key is held.

F18.note: windowClass narrows which window counts. Needed for explorer.exe, which is also the desktop and the taskbar.

F19.note: A binding with no hold, doubleTap, tripleTap or tapHold is tap-only and fires the instant the key goes down.

F20.note: Multi-tap. Adding doubleTap or tripleTap makes tap wait up to tapWindowMs for more taps (tap fires on the window closing, not on key-down). tapHold is tap, then press again and hold. Any action kind works in any slot. F16 and F17 can never be bound: the Cidoo V21 knob runtime owns them.

F21.note: layerToggle: flip a sticky layer on or off.

F22.note: swallow: eat the key and emit nothing. Use it so a raw F-key can never leak to an app.

encoder.note: The knob. Only directions that differ from stock (left Volume_Down, right Volume_Up, press Volume_Mute) are hooked, and only the AULA's own knob is remapped: the same key from any other keyboard passes through. Any action kind works here. doublePress, triplePress, hold, pressLeft (turn left while the button is down) and pressRight switch the button to tap-hold mode: press then waits tapWindowMs. hold and pressLeft/pressRight need the knob to report a real held press.

num.note: Sticky layer. Only 'toggle' exists. Space and CapsLock are protected and cannot be mapped.
